content: Yawe God, kiiwawo Ahes matakira iviyeveveni
Yawe God peroveta Aisaiya kawanama ivisisiya magha Ahes biidi iwona bo,
“Yawe yam God kibabiini da matakira iniyevevem. Tam rubana meboda wawaya raborabobodi yadi gawara kamonakinama, bo abame kiidamonakiye matakira kiiravine kunibaba.”
Bi Ahes iwona bo, “Tagu gematakira kiiravine Yawe God anibabiinina, bi tagu geyaguwiina Yawe God anaruyaghanina.”

Na Aisaiya iwonabodeyana bo, “Tami iiyawogha kiiwawo Deivid nosinosina, mmko kowaiyaneni! Tami yami kawakeekeema wawaya koberaberadi na samameyedi. Bo gerubana noko kiiravine, na yami kawakeekeema, bada koberabera na Yawe God yamameyeni?
Noko kiiravine Bada touna wosina matakira iniyevevemi. Na mma naboni: Wasike mamaragina inaropeya da inituwa tomogha, bi iniwaghawaghayeni Imaniwel.”

footnotes.text: Imaniwel yana basuna na God touda yawata.
